name: squeekchain
description: Squeekchain SqueekMining v6 on Sepolia: reads, checkpoints, claims and merges. Reads are permissionless; owner actions are prepared as unsigned transactions for the owner's wallet to sign. Testnet only.
safety: verify the deployment graph before acting (squeek_verify)
read ownership live, immediately before an owner action
a merge burns the donor NFT permanently — require an explicit human confirmation
this server never holds or requests a private key

tools.name: squeek_network_status
tools.description: Network-wide SqueekCore + SqueekMining state: settled round, Squeek block height, checkpoint lag, emission per day, total power, minted/supply cap, level table and whether a checkpoint can advance now.

tools.name: squeek_verify
tools.description: Verify both upgradeable proxies (implementation address, layout digest, proxy admin, implementation version) and the wiring between SqueekCore, SqueekMining, SqueekToken and SqueekNFT. Run this before trusting any other result.

tools.name: squeek_wallet_status
tools.description: Per-address holdings: live Squeek positions (level, active/pending power, merge cooldown block), claimable SQK, total power, network share and estimated SQK/day. Defaults to the connected wallet in the browser.

owner.description: 0x address to inspect (optional in the browser: defaults to the connected wallet)

tools.name: squeek_checkpoint_preview
tools.description: Whether checkpoint() can advance now (corePaused / roundSettled), with the reason when it cannot, the unsigned transaction and a gas estimate. checkpoint() is permissionless: no Squeek needed, no caller reward.

tools.name: squeek_claim_preview
tools.description: Simulated claim for an owner: total claimable SQK, the 32-ID transaction batches with per-batch gas, and any decoded revert. Signs nothing.

tokenIds.description: subset of token IDs to claim (optional; default all owned)

tools.name: squeek_merge_plan
tools.description: Same-level merge pairs that satisfy every onchain precondition (below max level, no pending activation, cooldown measured in completed Squeek blocks), with power before/after and the gain. Merging always burns the donor.

tools.name: squeek_merge_preview
tools.description: Simulate one merge for a survivor/donor pair: gas estimate, resulting level, and an explicit irreversibility warning. Signs nothing.

survivor.description: token ID that keeps its identity

tools.name: squeek_art
tools.description: Onchain DotGrid art and traits for a Squeek token: name, description, trait list and an SVG data URI rendered by the contract. Display it as an isolated image, never as inline markup.

tools.name: squeek_prepare_checkpoint
tools.description: Return an unsigned checkpoint() transaction (to/data/value/chainId) that the caller's wallet can sign. Use this from MCP; the web app can submit it directly.

tools.name: squeek_prepare_claim
tools.description: Return unsigned claim() transactions, one per 32-ID batch, for the owner's wallet to sign. Simulated first; ownership is re-read immediately before building.

tools.name: squeek_prepare_merge
tools.description: Return an unsigned merge() transaction for a survivor/donor pair plus the warning that the donor is burned permanently. Requires confirm: 'BURN-<donor>'.

confirm.description: must equal BURN-<donor> to acknowledge the burn

tools.name: squeek_request_checkpoint
tools.description: Open the user's wallet popup to submit checkpoint(). Works for any wallet, holder or not. The user still confirms in their wallet.

tools.name: squeek_request_claim
tools.description: Open the user's wallet popup to claim SQK for the connected owner (simulated first).

tools.name: squeek_request_merge
tools.description: Open the user's wallet popup to merge a pair. Requires confirm: 'BURN-<donor>' so an agent cannot burn an NFT by accident, and the UI still asks the human to type the donor ID.
